title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: DJ Moore questionable to return with shoulder injury
items.desc: DJ Moore is questionable to return with a shoulder injury.
items.impact: Viewers of the broadcast were able to see Moore get up and walk off under his own power after taking a big hit in the endzone. However, he is headed to the locker room for further x-ray examination and is questionable to return.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) active for Thursday night
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) is active for the Lions game against the Bills on Thursday.
items.impact: Reed was initially questionable to play with a foot injury, but was not among the inactives list. The veteran will try to bolster a struggling secondary against a passing attack that took down Houston on Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: T.J. Sanders (illness) inactive for Thursday
items.desc: T.J. Sanders (illness) is inactive for the Bills game against the Lions on Thursday.
items.impact: Sanders went down with an illness earlier this week and won't make it back in time for the Bills home opener. Landon Jackson is next in line for snaps, so expect an increased role on his part.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Skyler Bell (healthy scratch) inactive against Lions
items.desc: Skyler Bell (healthy scratch) is inactive against the Lions on Thursday.
items.impact: Bell missed the Bills opening contest, and will now miss their home opener. He's going to have to work hard to crack the receiver rotation in Buffalo.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) inactive for Thursday against Lions
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) is inactive for the Bills game against the Lions on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnson missed the Bills Week 1 contest against Houston, and is inactive yet again. He will rest up and hope to be available for Week 3. In his absence, Ray Davis will handle primary RB2 duties.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) officially misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Bowers missed another practice on Thursday, which makes it highly likely that he will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Chargers. Assuming he is ruled out for that matchup, fantasy managers should look for Michael Mayer to see more opportunities in Week 2 as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday.
items.impact: DeJean returned to practice in a limited fashion for the Eagles on Wednesday, which gives him a real chance to suit up and play in Week 2. We should have a better idea of whether or not he will play this week sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pec) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Greenard continues to trend the right way for Week 2, as he has been able to take part in both of Philadelphia's practices so far this week. It looks like he will be available to make his season debut against the Titans this week, which should bolster the Eagles' pass rush.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Carter (wrist) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Carter (wrist) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Philadelphia's star defensive tackle was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being sidelined by a wrist injury on Wednesday. It looks like he will play this week, which is a good development for the Eagles' defense ahead of a juicy matchup against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (rib) doesn't practice again Thursday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (rib) did not take part in Los Angeles' practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: McConkey seems to be trending towards missing Sunday's game against the Raiders, as he has yet to practice this week after suffering a rib injury in the season opener last week. That's unfortunate after his strong start in Week 1, and if he's ruled out prior to game time on Sunday, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris both stand to benefit from his absence from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ed Oliver suffers hip injury in pregame warmups Thursday
items.desc: Ed Oliver suffered a hip injury in pregame warmups for the Buffalo Bills and has been ruled out Thursday night according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Oliver's injury will be further evaluated, as the star defensive tackle's absence will leave the Buffalo defense with out a key interior presence against the Lions Thursday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (rest/Achilles) back to full practice Thursday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw (rest/Achilles) was back and practicing in full for the 49ers on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to return to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being sidelined for injury management purposes on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 2 and will continue to play a big role for San Francisco's defense in a favorable matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kaelon Black (groin) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Kaelon Black (groin) was added to the injury report as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has been picked up in many leagues as a high-end handcuff after looking good in Week 1, but he is now dealing with a groin injury and was limited on Thursday as a result. He could miss Sunday's game because of it, but we should get more clarity on the nature and degree of this injury sometime in the next day or two.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) returned to practice for the 49ers as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, McCaffrey returns to being a full participant at practice on Thursday after being given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day. He should be good to go for Week 2 and is primed for a huge workload against the Dolphins, especially now that Kaelon Black (groin) has been added to the injury report for the 49ers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) limited again Thursday
items.desc: George Kittle (Achilles) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Kittle was limited for another practice on Thursday, which should come as no surprise given that the team is trying to be cautious while he ramps his workload back up after suffering a devastating Achilles injury at the end of last season. He should return to a full workload sometime within the next few weeks if his recovery continues to progress well, at which point he will likely return to being a great fantasy asset for the remainder of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: San Francisco's star fullback was again limited on Thursday due to the finger injury that continues to bother him. He should play on Sunday without any limitations however, which is good news for Christian McCaffrey and San Francisco's running game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (rest/knee) back at practice as limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (rest/knee) was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Bosa was able to practice on Thursday, but the team continued to limit his workload and he didn't practice in full. He should play without any restrictions in Week 2, however, barring any setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eddy Pineiro (illness) absent from another practice Thursday
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro (illness) was absent from another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Pineiro is still recovering from an illness and was not at San Francisco's practice on Thursday as a result. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against Miami, however, as this illness is likely nothing more than a day-to-day issue.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Chop Robinson (concussion) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Miami's edge rusher recently entered the NFL's concussion protocols and was not able to practice on Thursday as a result. It looks like he is going to be sidelined this week, which is a tough break for the Dolphins ahead of a very tough matchup against the 49ers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (back) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nwangwu seems likely to miss another game this week due to the back injury that continues to bother him. The timetable for his return is unclear at this point, but his absence will continue to have minimal impact from a fantasy standpoint.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will McDonald IV (ankle) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Will McDonald IV (ankle) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: McDonald was added to New York's injury report on Thursday after starting the week fully healthy. He's now dealing with an ankle injury of some kind, and it looks like it could leave him sidelined in Week 2, which would make life easier for Jordan Love and Co. on the other side of the ball.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has yet to be officially ruled out for Week 2, but that will certainly happen, as his recovery timeline is not day-to-day and he hasn't practiced all week. Expect Adonai Mitchell and Kenyon Sadiq to benefit from his absence for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Van Ness remained limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday while he's in the NFL's concussion protocols. It looks likely that he will be cleared in time for Sunday's game, however, so he should be on the field for their favorable matchup against the Jets.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) was a limited participant at Green Bay's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Green Bay is dealing with several injuries to their offensive line right now, including Bako-Bewele, who was limited again with a knee issue. It looks likely that he will play through it this week, but that has yet to be determined officially.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Green Bay's starting offensive lineman missed the season opener due to a knee injury and remains on the injury report for the same issue. He could make his return to the lineup this week, but we won't know his status for sure until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cole Van Lanen (knee) considered limited again Thursday
items.desc: Cole Van Lanen (knee) was considered limited at another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Van Lanen's knee injury doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, as he has been able to practice in a limited fashion all week so far. He should be good to go for Week 2, barring any setbacks in his recovery, which is great news for the Jaguars ahead of a tough matchup against Denver's high-quality defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The young wideout remains banged up, still limited at practice due to a shoulder injury that he suffered in the season opener. It looks more likely than not that he will play in Week 2, but in the off-chance that he's sidelined, Parker Washington and Jakobi Meyers will both benefit from his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Foyesade Oluokun (wrist) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Foyesade Oluokun (wrist) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jacksonville's star defender is still managing a wrist injury and was limited as a result on Thursday. It looks likely that he will play in Week 2, but his official injury designation after practice on Friday should shed more light on his situation.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (wrist) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (wrist) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was again a limited participant on Thursday, which was to be expected, as the team has left him limited at all of their official practices so far in the regular season. He should be good to go for Week 2 and will see more work than usual if Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) is sidelined against the Broncos.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) limited again Thursday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: A hip injury continues to bother Allen, but it looks likely that he will play through it in Week 2, as that's what he did in the season opener last week. He's not fantasy relevant at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: RJ Harvey (hamstring) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: RJ Harvey (hamstring) was upgraded to a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Harvey wasn't able to practice on Wednesday due to a new hamstring injury, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 2, although we won't know for sure until closer to game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) was sidelined at Denver's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A foot injury has left Mims sidelined at practice all week. It may very well leave him inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, but his potential absence wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: O'Neill was limited at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday, which is a bad sign for his availability for Week 2. If he is ruled out, Minnesota's offensive front will be weaker than usual against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) was a limited participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: A chest injury has left the veteran limited at two-straight practices to start the week. It looks more likely than not that he will play in Week 2, which would be great for Minnesota's defense ahead of what projects to be a tough matchup against Chicago's red-hot offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (wrist) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Blake Cashman (wrist) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cashman was upgraded to a full participant at Thursday's practice after being limited by a wrist injury on Wednesday. He should play this week, which is good news for Minnesota's defense ahead of a tough matchup against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jauan Jennings (personal) absent from another practice Thursday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings (personal) was absent from another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A personal issue of some kind left Jennings absent from a second-straight practice on Thursday. It's currently unclear whether or not it will affect his availability for Week 2, but he isn't fantasy relevant at this point in the season, so his injury status doesn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Murray (concussion) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Kyler Murray (concussion) was a limited participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Murray is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and remained limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as a result. It seems like he's trending the right way for Week 2, but even if he's cleared to play in time, the team might decide to play it safe and let him sit out for another week, which would give Carson Wentz another start on Sunday. This is a situation that fantasy managers should be monitoring over the next couple of days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Giddens (knee) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: DJ Giddens (knee) was absent from Indianapolis' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Giddens is a new addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He has been added because of a knee injury that he's dealing with, and it looks like he could miss Sunday's game because of it. He is currently nothing more than a depth RB for the Colts, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't read too much into his injury status for Sunday night's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Richardson returned to the practice field on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice due to a groin injury. He was a full participant and it looks like he should be fully healthy heading into the weekend, though he will continue to be just the QB2 on this offense behind Daniel Jones for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Alec Pierce (heel) officially did not take part in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Surprisingly, Pierce was a non-participant at the team's second practice of the week on Thursday. He's only listed with the same heel issue that has been bothering him for months, so it remains unclear if this is a load management move by the team or if he actually aggravated the injury to some degree. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as Josh Downs and Keenan Allen will both see more work than usual if the Colts are without their apparent WR1 this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keenan Allen (rest) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Keenan Allen (rest) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran was a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. The team was simply limiting his workload as a load management tactic, and he should be fully good to go for Week 2. He may see more work than usual if Alec Pierce (heel) or Ashton Dulin (ankle) are sidelined against Kansas City.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Dulin is trending towards being sidelined in Week 2 due to the ankle injury that he's managing. Alec Pierce (heel) is also risk of being sidelined for Sunday night's game, so these injuries may lead to more involvement for Keenan Allen and Josh Downs against the Chiefs this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Jones (calf) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Chris Jones (calf) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kansas City's star defensive lineman continues to be limited at practice due to a nagging calf injury. It looks unlikely to affect his availability for Week 2, but we won't know for sure until sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie should be good to go for Sunday night's game against the Colts, despite suffering a shoulder injury last week. He has been a full participant at practice all week and will likely be without an injury designation heading into the weekend, barring any setbacks with his recovery.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Josh Simmons (back) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Simmons is going to be sidelined for another game in Week 2, as he was still a non-participant in the team's practice on Thursday. It looks like rookie Kahlil Benson will once again get the starting nod in his place, which is fine because he looked great in his NFL debut against a tough Broncos defense last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brandin Cooks works out with Ravens
items.desc: Brandin Cooks worked out with the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: The Ravens brought in the 32-year old for an official workout on Thursday. This comes in light of the fact that they may be without their top wideout for a short period of time, with Zay Flowers (hamstring) likely to be sidelined for a week or two at least. The workout ended without a deal for Cooks, but we could possibly see him join the team sometime within the next few weeks if they continue to need help at the wide receiver position.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Samaje Perine (illness) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Samaje Perine (illness) did not take part in Cincinnati's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back is a new addition to the injury report, being listed with an illness that left him sidelined at practice on Thursday. He's likely considered day-to-day for the time being, but in the off-chance that he doesn't play this week, Tahj Brooks would have to step up and play the RB2 role behind Chase Brown against a tough Houston defense on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Burrow (back) limited at practice again Thursday
items.desc: Joe Burrow (back) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Burrow was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday due to back soreness that he's battling. It looks like he's trending the right way for Week 2, however, as he was able to throw passes on Thursday after not doing so on Wednesday. His status should be closely monitored heading into the weekend, as if he playing at less than 100% against Houston's tough defense, that will have a negative impact on the outlook of Chase Brown, Ja'Marr Chase, and Tee Higgins for this week's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (rest) returned to practice as a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran was back at practice on Thursday after getting Wednesday off as a rest day. He should be fully good to go for Week 2 and may be primed for more work than usual with Nico Collins (hamstring) trending towards being sidelined against the Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Nico Collins (hamstring) officially did not take part in Houston's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins did not take part in Houston's practice on Thursday, which is no surprise after he was recently diagnosed with a Grade 1 hamstring strain. It looks likely that he will miss Sunday's game against the Bengals, and he could miss another week or two beyond that depending on how his recovery goes. If he misses time, fantasy managers should expect Jaylin Noel, Kayshon Boutte, and Dalton Schultz to all see more work in his absence.
